self.text: Hey there! I’m Matteo, a mid‑30s history buff from Turkey who loves a good swing dance as a way to unwind. I’m pretty comfortable with numbers and love crunching statistics, especially when it helps me see patterns in historical trends. When I’m working on a project or just exploring a new topic, I enjoy walking through it step by step, breaking things down into manageable pieces. I’m always up for a quick chat—short exchanges over coffee or a quick call are my favorite ways to keep the conversation flowing. If you ever need a little explanation on something, I’m happy to explain things in a clear, friendly way. Whether we meet up in person or connect online, I’m flexible and can make time for a chat or a project review. I’m free most Sundays in the morning, so that’s a great slot if you want to catch up or collaborate on something interesting. Looking forward to sharing ideas, learning together, and maybe even swapping swing dance tips over a coffee!
